title: Micron posted an 87% gross margin on memory chips
angle: The component supplier is capturing the AI margin, and it has already sold most of 2027.

frames.text: Micron just posted an 87% gross margin on memory chips.
Quarterly revenue, against $11.32B in the same quarter a year ago.
Full fiscal year came in at 81.1%, up from 41.1% the year before.
More than 75% of next year's output is already committed.
We do not have line of sight to when supply and demand return to balance.
Everybody's arguing about which lab wins. Micron is charging all of them rent.
